title: PR Reviewer LoRA Dataset Schema
description: General-purpose dataset schema for fine-tuning the PR Reviewer model using LoRA. The training dataset must NOT include the held-out test branches (tuba-test, tuba-test-hardcoded-secret, tuba-test-redundant-boolean, tuba-test-unclosed-resource, tuba-test-clean-change).

lora_objectives: Maintain high recall for actual issues
Avoid generating findings on clean PRs (tuba-test-clean-change style)
Minimize reviewer role leakage (ensure reviewers stick strictly to correctness, security, or maintainability roles)
Avoid over-fitting to specific bug patterns; generalize general PR review capabilities
metadata.note_on_source_scenario_id: All three reviewer training instances generated for a single PR scenario must share the exact same 'source_scenario_id'. For example, if a scenario represents a hardcoded secret, the 'security_validation' instance must report the finding, whereas 'correctness_logic' and 'maintainability' instances must yield empty findings list, teaching the model reviewer role discipline.

id.description: Unique identifier for the training sample

scenario_category.description: Specific scenario type from correctness_logic, security_validation, maintainability, or clean_change categories

difficulty.description: Difficulty level of identifying the issue

language.description: The programming language of the codebase

reviewer.description: The reviewer agent personality this sample fine-tunes

pr_diff.description: The unified diff containing the changes made in the PR

context.description: Associated surrounding code context for context awareness

is_clean.description: True if no issue should be found by this reviewer for the code change

source_scenario_id.description: Identifier to group correctness_logic, security_validation, and maintainability reviewer instances originating from the same scenario
